text: You are going to investigate the effect of concentration on diffusion.
You will use cubes of agar which contain universal indicator. You will place the cubes of agar into
different concentrations of hydrochloric acid solution and measure the time taken for the acid to
diffuse to the centre of each cube.
Read all the instructions but DO NOT DO THEM until you have drawn a table for your results
in the space provided in 1(a)(i).

parts.text:
A student used DCPIP solution to compare the concentration of vitamin C in five solutions.
The student used this method:
• Put 1cm of 1% DCPIP solution into a test-tube.
• Use a syringe to add drops of 125 mg per dm vitamin C solution to the test-tube.
• Keep adding drops of vitamin C solution until the DCPIP solution becomes colourless.
• Record the total volume of the 125 mg per dm vitamin C solution added.
This method was repeated with four other concentrations of vitamin C solution.
